title: MSO Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About us**  
  
  

One team. Global challenges. Infinite opportunities. At Viasat, we’re on a mission to deliver connections with the capacity to change the world. For more than 35 years, Viasat has helped shape how consumers, businesses, governments and militaries around the globe communicate. We’re looking for people who think big, act fearlessly, and create an inclusive environment that drives positive impact to join our team.

  
  
**What you'll do**  
  
  

This position interacts directly with our commercial customers and with various internal groups, including Network and Service Operations Engineers, and program management.

This position includes the MSO duties above and in addition will be working closely with DevOps engineers to investigate and help tackle complex SW and HW issues. Will also connect with the Tactical Assistance Center/TAC on identifying issues with the mobility network, all with a goal of improving overall mobility performance in multiple areas. This person will also have to be able to train peers on the latest process or technology.

  
  
**The day-to-day**  
  
  

* Monitor support channels to ensure a rapid response and resolution to any problem or inquiry
* Support the provisioning and configuration of new terminals
* Monitor our core service elements for exceptions
* Follow appropriate critical issue procedures
* Thoroughly documenting incident progress and resolution details in our ticketing system
* Communicate outages and maintenance notifications to our customers

  
**What you'll need**  
  
  

* A Bachelor’s Degree in a technical discipline or in lieu of education, 3-5 years of relevant experience/military experience
* Fluent in Python, Java, C#
* Knowledge in SQL, JavaScript, and HTML
* Experience working with Linux/Unix
* Prior experience with CRM tools, such as Salesforce
* Solid grasp of TCP/IP and Broadband Networks
* Adept at performing troubleshooting of complex systems and equipment
* Experience with the use of Network Monitoring Systems
* Experience with hardware and software elements involved in IP networking and satellite communications
* Advanced experience with Splunk
* Packet capture / wire shark skills

  
**What will help you on the job**  
  
  

* 2+ years in a NOC environment or similar technical support role
* 3+ years’ experience in a customer-facing service capacity
* Passionate about customer support and service quality, and enjoys multi-tasking in a fast paced, team environment
* We are looking for someone that enjoys working with the latest networking technologies and is always looking for ways to personally chip in to overall process improvement
* Good interpersonal skills, including the ability to connect with both technical and non-technical audiences

  
**EEO Statement**  
  
  

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer with hands-on experience in Solar EPC, Substations, HT/LT systems and Transmission Lines and related electrical works.

Key Responsibilities:

Study tender documents, BOQs and drawings and prepare scope summaries.

Prepare complete BOQ/BOM/BOS, estimates and material requirements.

Review and prepare SLDs, layouts, electrical drawings and basic design calculations.

Raise RFQs, obtain quotations and conduct techno-commercial comparisons.

Develop and maintain & bring in strong vendor, contractor and subcontractor relationships.

Manage and supervise project execution, site activities, testing and commissioning.

Coordinate works related to solar plants, substations, transformers, HT/LT systems and transmission lines.

Requirements:

B.E./B.Tech in Electrical / EEE.

Minimum 4 years of experience in Solar EPC and power infrastructure projects.

Strong knowledge of BOQ preparation, electrical drawings, procurement and site execution.

Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Excel; PVsyst/ETAP preferred.

Existing vendor and contractor network will be an added advantage.

Willingness to travel to project sites.

Work Location: In person

title: Sr. Manager Enterprise Support India, ES - Strategic Industries - Strat
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.  
  
The AWS Support team is seeking an Enterprise Support Manager that enjoys solving problems, working with customers, and who has a background from a variety of different fields. The Role needs experience of leading teams responsible for building or managing full application stacks from the system (Linux or Windows) up through a custom application, managing part of a network from layer 3 and higher, or web-related programming that includes the consumption of web services we’d like to talk with you!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As Enterprise Support Manager, you will lead a team of Technical Account Managers who are the primary operational point of contact for your customer, helping to plan, review, and oversee ongoing operations of business critical applications. You will leverage your broad experience to work closely with sales leadership to plan and ensure successful launch and operations of AWS’s largest application workloads. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Sr Analyst-IT-Nagios Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

 **Job Description**

Senior Nagios Engineer manages and enhances Nagios systems to monitor enterprise infrastructure, networks, and applications. This role ensures accurate alerting, efficient system performance, and ongoing platform reliability.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, and maintain Nagios Core, Nagios XI monitoring solutions
* Upgrade Nagios and related plugins for system and network monitoring.
* Good hands on experience in Linix/ Unix servers.
* Develop and refine monitoring scripts and templates for consistent coverage.
* Monitor and troubleshoot: Linux, Windows and applications
* Configure and manage: Hosts, services, host groups, and service groups, Active and passive checks, Alerts, escalations, and notifications
* Integrate Nagios XI with: SNMP, NRPE, NCPA, NSClient++, Ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Jira, etc.), Email, SMS, and collaboration tools
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and provide incident reports
* Optimize monitoring performance and reduce alert noise (alert fatigue)
* Build dashboards, reports, and capacity planning metrics
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, and security teams
* Create and maintain monitoring documentation and SOPs
* Support audits, compliance requirements, and best operational practices
* Analyze performance metrics to identify trends and optimization opportunities.
* Creating dashboards and reports.
* Maintain SOX-compliant documentation for monitoring configurations and changes.
* Collaborate with DC Ops, NOC, and infrastructure teams to resolve system issues.
* Document monitoring standards and ensure consistent best practices.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in IT or equivalent experience.
* 5 - 8 years of experience managing Nagios XI in enterprise environments.
* Strong Linux and scripting knowledge (Bash, Python, Perl).
* Experience with SNMP, network protocols, and performance metrics.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Experience with agent-based and agentless monitoring
* Familiarity with performance monitoring and capacity management
* Knowledge of log analysis and alert correlation

Tools & Technologies (Nice to Have)

Other monitoring tools: SCOM, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics

Cloud monitoring (AWS, Azure, GCP)

ITSM tools (ServiceNow)

 **Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For:**

Demonstrated a growth mindset by staying curious and continuously learning, embracing challenges, and improving themselves.  

  
  
**Additional Information**

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.  
  
**How We Work:**  
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

* **We collaborate:** Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* **We innovate:** At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* **We execute:** We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**  
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

**Who We Are:**  
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.  
  
Mattel is an Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers, and all applicants will receive consideration for employment.

The Culture at Mattel  
Corporate Philanthropy

title: Lead Engineer – 1 - Platforms & Solutions
description:
Overview:

We are currently looking for a Global IT Infrastructure & Operations Analyst to join our team in Europe. The Global IT Infrastructure & Operations accountabilities include:

* Provide global infrastructure technologies and end-user services focused on availability, quality, cost, and reduced time-to-delivery.
* Define and govern integrated service management practices across global and sector IT services and products.
* Optimize global IT assets and services.
* Manage and provide Software Licenses.
* Provide analytics and derive insights that drive continuous service improvements.
* Prevent business disruption via integrated monitoring and automation.

This role supports the IT Infrastructure & Operations Asset Management Team in Europe.

The primary objective of IT Asset Management is to enable the IT organization to provide effective service to its customers at a justifiable cost through asset lifecycle management. IT Asset Management creates this lifecycle by integrating the key activities of asset management into a unified discipline, focused on the hardware and software that make up our infrastructure and applications. Key activities are: procurement, financial management, contract management, supplier selection, warehousing, maintenance and warranty management, and retirement.

  
Responsibilities:

* Control the lifecycle management of the IT assets in Europe
* Support regional, sector and global demands for IT assets.
* Execute Asset Management internal controls in Europe sector.
* Support Internal reconciliations, local and global IT audits of software applications.
* Implement Continual Service Improvement (CSI) the processes needed to manage all existing and future IT Asset lifecycle.
* Maintain the accuracy and completeness of inventory of hardware and software & track the current usage. Resolving gaps identified in Weekly Key Quality Indicators (KQI).
* Assist IT Purchasing Managers in procuring Hardware & Software and work with Europe sector users to understand IT Asset needs, identify appropriate solutions and help source cost effective vendors.
* Proactively identify purchasing, leasing, maintenance, and usage trends and identify and needed corrections to minimize costs.
* Interacts with other IT and business team management to drive the IT Asset Management team vision on optimizing assets and costs.
* Periodically build and communicate scorecards related to assets management lifecycle to understand asset lifecycle status, process variances, and cost drivers

Qualifications:

* University / College Degree in Social Sciences, Business Management, Computer Science, Master of Information Science, or related field, or related professional experience
* Experience in Hardware & Software Asset Management (Compliance, licenses Software Terms and Conditions) a plus.
* Experience using myIT Services is required.
* Data Management skills to develop insights and analytics to guide key decisions is a plus.
* ITIL certification is preferable
* Knowledge on local regulations and governmental requirements, reporting capabilities is required
* Effective written and verbal English communication skills is a must
* Experience in Program, Project, Service Management
* Strong vendor management, communications, influencing and partnering skills
* General Technical knowledge and background to understand and apply technology relating to Hardware Infrastructure (PCs, Servers, Network Equipment, Printers, etc.)
* Ability to work with senior IT and Business management Teams.
* Must be extremely organized and pay attention to detail.
* Detail oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Business Intelligence Engineer I, Global Reporting & Standards (GRS)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Global Reporting & Standards (GRS) team within the Global Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (RME) Central Team is looking for an exceptional business intelligence engineer to join us. In this role, you will work on an analytical team to bust myths, create insights, and produce recommendations to help Central RME to deliver world class service to the Amazon network. As part of the team will be involved in all phases of research, experiment, design and analysis, including defining research questions, designing experiments, identifying data requirements, and communicating insights and recommendations. You'll also be expected to continuously learn new systems, tools, and industry best practices to analyze big data and enhance our analytics. These are exciting fast-paced businesses in which we get to work on extremely interesting analytical problems, in an environment where you get to learn from other engineers and apply business intelligence to help leadership make informed decisions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You build mid-size to large BI solutions or components of larger solutions. Your focus is at the team level, working on a major portion of existing or new BI artifacts (e.g., contributing to the team’s datamart) or owning a difficult report or analysis.  
  
You assume responsibility for the code, queries, reports and analyses you inherit or produce. You get your analyses and code reviewed. You test your code by validating outputs against source data, business logic, and related metrics  
  
You have a deep understanding of data lineage of your team’s BI solutions: the technical systems by which the data is generated; how the metrics are aggregated; and how the resulting business intelligence is consumed, interpreted and acted upon by the business.  
  
You are a passionate advocate for your customer. In addition to metrics definitions, you learn the business context and technologies behind your team’s data infrastructure. You work effectively with customers (e.g., business teams, Data Scientists, etc.) and other internal partners to ensure deliverables are aligned with expectations.  
  
You invent, refine and develop your BI solutions to ensure they are meeting the needs of the business and team goals.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
* Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
* Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

title: Lead - Network & Design Engineer (DNS, BIND, Route53)
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled Network & DNS Design Engineer to join our Network Engineering team. This role is responsible for the design, governance, automation and L3 support of enterprise DNS, domain management and core network services across cloud, datacentre and corporate environments.

The successful candidate will be a subject matter expert in DNS technologies including AWS Route53, Microsoft Active Directory-integrated DNS and BIND, with responsibility for ensuring the availability, security and scalability of critical name resolution services supporting both internal users and customer-facing platforms.

The role requires a strong engineering mindset, a passion for automation, and practical experience applying AI-driven solutions to improve operational efficiency, governance and service reliability.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement and manage enterprise DNS services across AWS Route53, Microsoft DNS and BIND platforms.

* Own the design and governance of public and private DNS infrastructure, including hosted zones, delegation, forwarding, conditional forwarding and resolver services.

* Manage the organisation's domain portfolio, including registrations, renewals, transfers, security controls and lifecycle governance.

* Design and support DNS services integrated with Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), ensuring reliable operation of authentication, Group Policy and Windows-based services.

* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex DNS, domain and network-related incidents.

* Develop and maintain DNS, domain and network standards, documentation and operational processes.

* Design and implement automation solutions using APIs, scripting and Infrastructure as Code.

* Leverage AI-assisted tooling to improve DNS management, domain governance, change validation, troubleshooting and operational reporting.

* Collaborate with infrastructure, security and application teams to deliver resilient and secure services.

* Contribute to the design and support of routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing and hybrid-cloud networking solutions.

### **Essential skills & experience:**

* Extensive experience with AWS Route53, including public and private hosted zones, delegation and DNS governance.

* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft DNS running on Active Directory Domain Controllers.

* Strong experience with BIND DNS administration and architecture.

* Deep understanding of DNS protocols, DNSSEC, recursive and authoritative DNS services.

* Experience managing enterprise domain portfolios and registrar relationships.

* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching and network security principles.

* Experience with DNS/IPAM integration and tooling.

* Experience with automation technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform or similar.

* Experience using APIs and Infrastructure as Code to automate operational processes.

* Experience applying AI technologies to infrastructure management, operational efficiency or service automation.

### **Desirable experience:**

* AWS networking and infrastructure services.

* F5 DNS/GTM and load balancing technologies.

* NetBox, SolarWinds, Infoblox or similar IPAM platforms.

* VPN, firewall and cloud networking technologies.

* GitOps and modern infrastructure automation practices.

* Experience supporting large-scale global enterprise environments.

### **Key Attributes**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

* Automation-first mindset.

* Excellent documentation and governance discipline.

* Ability to lead technical standards and best practices.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Passion for innovation and the practical application of AI within infrastructure operations.

**Why join us?**

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

**An inclusive environment to thrive**

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.

**Be rewarded for your efforts**

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

**We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply***.*

*"****At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity.****"*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Business Intelligence Engineer, ShipTech
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Shiptech Visibility team is responsible to deliver end-to-end supply chain visibility by blending telemetry data from multiple sources—IoT sensors, GPS trackers, EDI feeds, and carrier APIs—with varying accuracy into high-confidence contextual milestones. We eliminate visibility gaps across the logistics network and enable businesses to operate with real-time exception management and shipment predictability. We provide high-fidelity tracking signals with geofencing capabilities, accurate EDD predictions, and contextual shipment milestone updates. We secure today's small parcel operations while building tomorrow's intermodal connectivity infrastructure.  
  
  
  
  
The ideal candidate relishes working with large volumes of data, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts, and, above all else, is passionate about data and analytics. The candidate is an expert with business intelligence tools and passionately partners with the business to identify strategic opportunities where data-backed insights drive value creation. An effective communicator, the candidate crisply translates analysis result into executive-facing business terms. The candidate works aptly with internal and external teams to push the projects across the finishing line. The candidate is a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, able to think big (while paying careful attention to detail), and enjoys working in a fast-paced and global team.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Work closely with the BIEs, DEs and SDEs in the team and collaborate effectively with product managers to create scalable solutions for business problems.
* Use AI-first approach in solving problems to achieve speed and throughput
* Create program goals and related metrics, track progress, and manage through obstacles to help team achieve objectives
* Identify opportunities for improvement or automation in existing data processes and lead the changes using your business acumen and data handling skills.
* Use the best practice on data integrity, design, test, implementation, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to transportation operations strategy development based on data analysis
* Lead strategic projects to formalize and scale organizational processes
* Build and manage weekly, monthly and quarterly business review metrics.
* Build data reports and dashboards: Leverage your data skills and technical means (SQL, Excel, etc.) to improve on business efficiency across programs.

  
About the team  
Shiptech Visibility team is responsible to deliver end-to-end supply chain visibility by blending telemetry data from multiple sources—IoT sensors, GPS trackers, EDI feeds, and carrier APIs—with varying accuracy into high-confidence contextual milestones. title: Embedded Software Technical Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Embedded Software Technical Lead**, you will lead the implementation and delivery of assigned firmware modules and workstreams for Kandou's new ASIC products, under the technical direction of the overall Firmware Lead. You will remain hands-on in coding, debugging and bring-up, while mentoring engineers working on your scope. The overall Firmware Lead owns the firmware roadmap, team-wide priorities and release decisions; this role owns execution within the agreed architecture and project plan.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the design, development, test and maintenance of assigned real-time firmware modules for high-speed heterogeneous SoC platforms.
* Translate agreed system requirements into module designs and hardware/software interfaces; review architecture and interface changes with the Firmware Lead and architects.
* Plan and coordinate assigned work: estimate effort, track dependencies and milestones, and escalate risks and priority conflicts to the Firmware Lead.
* Remain hands-on in C/C++ development, RTOS integration, low-level drivers, bootloaders, secure boot and reliable firmware updates.
* Drive bring-up, hardware/software integration and root-cause analysis for assigned firmware, working with silicon design and validation teams.
* Lead module-level design and code reviews, apply team coding and test standards, and provide validation evidence and documentation for firmware release reviews.
* Mentor engineers on assigned work, guide implementation decisions and share knowledge; align broader technical decisions with the Firmware Lead.

Coordinate with validation and applications teams to resolve integration and field issues; improve the software tools supporting silicon development and debug.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of experience designing, coding and debugging real-time embedded applications in C and/or C++, including 2+ years providing technical leadership for firmware modules or projects.
* Demonstrated ownership of firmware module delivery from requirements and design through bring-up, validation and release integration within a wider engineering team.
* Strong embedded SoC experience with bare-metal and RTOS environments, including RTOS porting and integration with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and hands-on bare-metal or RTOS firmware development for RV32/RV64 cores, including trap handling, CSR access and toolchain setup.
* Board and SoC bring-up using JTAG and other debug mechanisms; ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, drivers and hardware.
* Experience interfacing with hardware and peripherals using SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C and JTAG, and implementing bootloaders, secure boot and firmware update flows.
* Proficiency in Python or another modern scripting language, and practical use of Git/GitLab, CI, Make/CMake and automated unit and integration testing.
* Strong design-review, documentation, organisational, presentation and mentoring skills; ability to align cross-functional teams and learn new technical areas.

**Useful Experience**

* Heterogeneous multicore systems with scalar and vector processors; embedded Linux, memory and network interfaces, and virtual memory.
* High-speed signalling technologies such as PCIe and CXL, including link training, equalization and retimer/redriver interaction with host and device PHYs.
* Firmware for Active Electrical Cable (AEC) or retimer/redriver ASICs, including cable diagnostics, eye margin monitoring, temperature/voltage telemetry and power-state management.
* Management and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C, MCTP and CMIS; SerDes technology and PHY register-level tuning.
* Simulation, co-simulation and FPGA platforms for pre-silicon firmware development; HyperBus and HyperRAM technologies.

Cryptographic algorithms and secure firmware lifecycle practices, including authenticated updates, recovery and rollback protection.

If this is the role you have been looking for and you want to be part of a growing Company, with an exciting future then we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!!

title: Software Development Manager, FinTech General Ledger
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


We're looking for an experienced Software Development Manager to lead one of the engineering teams responsible for Amazon's General Ledger (GL) and financial close systems — the mission\-critical technology that accurately accounts for approximately 900 million transactions per month across the entire company. This is a rare opportunity to lead at the center of a multi\-year financial transformation: re\-architecting how Amazon runs its General Ledger and closes its books, and building the next generation of these systems for 2028 and beyond.  

  

You'll lead a team of software engineers who own critical parts of the close lifecycle — spanning sub\-ledger integration, journal and ledger processing, and close orchestration — delivering high\-impact automation for our Finance and Global Business Services (FGBS) customers. As close timelines compress and expectations for accuracy and speed rise, your team's work directly shapes the confidence Amazon has in its financial numbers, at scale.  

  

This role is defined by change. Amazon's General Ledger is being re\-built and its surrounding processes redesigned end to end — close calendars are shortening, manual touchpoints are being engineered out, and the target\-state architecture is being built now. You will operate with significant autonomy to set technical strategy, make architectural decisions that carry across the current and future state, and lead your team through the transition without compromising the reliability of a system that cannot fail during close.  

  

The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise in large\-scale distributed systems, preferably a background in financial or ERP systems, and a proven ability to lead teams through ambiguous, high\-stakes transformation while keeping production healthy. You work backwards from customer needs, you're comfortable when both the business problem and the technology approach require invention, and you can hold a long\-term vision while shipping incremental value every sprint. You'll partner closely with finance, controllership, product, and technology stakeholders to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable, automation\-first solutions.  

  

If you're energized by leading a team that is redefining the future of Amazon's General Ledger — modernizing the technology, compressing the close, and building toward a touchless, self\-healing future state — we want to hear from you.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead architecture, design, and delivery of GL and close systems, making technical decisions that balance near\-term reliability with the long\-term target state
* Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for your team, working backwards from FGBS customer needs and the broader GL modernization program
* Guide your team through system and process transformation — sequencing migration, modernization, and automation work while protecting the integrity and timeliness of every close
* Build, mentor, and manage a high\-performing team of software engineers, fostering a culture of automation\-first thinking and technical excellence
* Own operational metrics and system health for GL and close systems, establishing mechanisms to monitor progress and drive continuous improvement
* Partner with finance, controllership, and product teams to translate complex accounting requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Recruit, hire, and develop top engineering talent, creating clear career paths and coaching that helps your team grow
* Champion automation and rapid iteration, continuously eliminating manual touchpoints to shorten Amazon's financial close timeline

  

About the team  

We are the engineering organization behind Amazon's General Ledger and month\-end close — one of the most complex and high\-stakes financial processes in the company. Our teams own the timely and accurate closure of sub\-ledgers and the General Ledger, ensuring that approximately 900 million transactions per month are accounted for with precision, along with the foundational GL functions — ledger setups, posting and recurring schedules, journal processing, and close orchestration — that keep Amazon's financial engine running.  

  

What sets us apart is a relentless drive toward automation and modernization. We are actively building the next generation of Amazon's General Ledger and redesigning the close processes around it, with the goal of a faster, more resilient, and ultimately touchless close. Every sprint moves us closer to that future state — and this role helps lead the way there.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Engineer, Identity and Access Management
description:

You will design, implement, and maintain policies and systems that control user identities, credentials, roles, and permissions across various IT platforms and applications. You will also monitor and audit user activities, troubleshoot issues, and comply with IT standards and regulations. To succeed in this role, you will need strong technical skills, analytical thinking, problem\-solving abilities, and knowledge of IT security best practices.

	+ Perform upgrades, patching, and configuration changes in accordance with change management processes
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to directory services, authentication, and identity workflows
	+ Maintain high availability and disaster recovery configurations for IAM infrastructure
* Linux Administration
	+ Manage and maintain Linux\-based servers hosting IAM applications and directory services
	+ Perform OS\-level troubleshooting, log analysis, and performance diagnostics
	+ Implement and maintain system hardening standards and security configurations
	+ Coordinate with infrastructure teams on server provisioning, networking, and storage
* Scripting \& Automation

	+ Automate provisioning, de\-provisioning, and reconciliation workflows
	+ Build tooling to support bulk directory operations, data migrations, and schema management

	+ Participate in on\-call rotation and provide escalation support for P1/P2 incidents
	+ Mentor junior team members and contribute to team knowledge sharing

* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash and/or Python for automation and operational tooling
* Solid understanding of LDAP concepts: schema, replication, ACIs, indexing, and directory architecture
* Experience supporting enterprise IAM in a production environment
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting multi\-factor authentication (MFA) solutions, including hardware tokens, YubiKeys, authenticator applications, push notifications, and/or certificate\-based authentication.
* Familiarity with authentication protocols: LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth2/OIDC
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills
* Requires extensive knowledge of relevant IT system issues, techniques, and implications across all existing server platforms.
* Must have extensive knowledge in networking, databases, systems, and/or Web operations.

 **Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Experience with additional ForgeRock/Ping Identity products (AM, PingFederate, PingDirectory)
* Familiarity with HashiCorp Vault or other secrets management solutions
* Experience with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) in the context of IAM workloads
* Knowledge of SCIM provisioning standards
* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and hybrid identity architectures

* Experience working with a diverse range of data sources/streams and managing these effectively

* Knowledge of multiple operating systems and related utilities and hardware
* Knowledge of storage management, TCP/IP, and network monitoring and tools
* Strong background in operations, processes, solutions, and technologies
* Strong understanding of policy, compliance, and best practice Identity Access Management principles

* Knowledge of infrastructure, key processes, and technology\-oriented risk issues, specifically around Identity Access Management and privacy
* Results oriented, business focused, and successful at interfacing across multiple organizational units

title: EPM Solution Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.**


Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

 **Job Description**  

As an **EPM Solution Engineer**, you will act as a key technical expert for SGS's Hyperion, Essbase and related EPM applications, driving their development, stability and continuous improvement. You will ensure solutions follow industry best practices for coding, architecture, security and performance while applying your expertise across the software development lifecycle.


You will play an active role in development and enhancement initiatives, ensuring business requirements are understood, challenged where necessary, and translated into scalable, sustainable solutions. You will assess the impact of new requirements and provide technical guidance that balances business needs with long\-term system integrity and maintainability.


You will oversee the maintenance and support of EPM applications, including metadata management, calculation scripts, business rules, reports and dashboards. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and service providers, you will manage requests, support incident resolution and contribute to strategic initiatives such as platform upgrades, ERP transformation projects and the evolution of Oracle EPM solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee that the software development activity is carried out in accordance with SGS and market standards.
* Executes the validation of the technical designs \& oversees the application development activity and ensures that deliverables follow the defined \& market coding, architecture and security rules and guidelines.
* Ensuring that development estimates made by partners are reasonable and acceptable.
* Ensure that the development activities in the field of applications development and projects comply with the SGS technical standards and quality.
* Monitor 2nd or 3rd Level Support, working closely with AM Teams, business users, infrastructure team and application outsourcer (Oracle).
* Attend internal and external service meetings to discuss issues and improvement plans.
* Manage and monitor issues closely and ensure their resolution according to applicable escalation procedures.
* Perform regular service quality checks on incident tickets and requests and prepare improvement plans.
* Maintain the access and security configurations, ensuring the right level of control in line with the standards required by system auditors and internal controls.
* Monitor monthly maintenance activities: Maintain metadata, member list, FX Rates, business rules and validation checks.
* Support the year end Rollover activities, and support any other activity related financial closing.
* Oversee technical architecture activities such as patching, backups or application copies, working closely with DBA and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teams, Solution Architects, Delivery managers and Application Outsourcers for any initiative that will require SGS engagement.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **Minimum 5 years’ experience in Hyperion or related EPM products** on any of the following processes:
	+ Financial Planning and Budgeting.
	+ Enterprise Data Management \& **Essbase**.
	+ Financial Consolidation and Closing.
	+ EPM Technical Architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with EPM development, including business rules, calculation scripts, metadata management and reporting.
* Experience supporting, enhancing and maintaining enterprise EPM applications.
* **Oracle EPM Cloud experience** is highly desirable.
* Experience with EPM upgrades, migrations or transformation initiatives is desirable.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITIL) principles.
* Ability to assess the impact of business requirements and communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance business requirements with long\-term system stability and architectural best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence decisions and provide trusted technical guidance.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across global teams and external partners.
* Proactive, flexible and able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Embraces change and continuous improvement.

  

**Additional Information** **Why SGS?**

* Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
* Enjoy a **flexible schedule and a hybrid work model.**
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
* Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

**Apply Now**:  

At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!

title: Lead Network Engineer
description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Network Engineer.

 **In this role, you will:**

* Lead the review, resolution and implementation for the most complex technical issues and initiatives related to large scale network applications, data systems, voice and other technical products and services
* Use and create diagnostic, simulation and other tools to maintain, troubleshoot and restore service or data to systems
* Evaluate or review queries to extract data, create standard procedures, or perform limited programming to fine tune systems supported
* Research performance trends and recommend process improvements
* Perform complex migrations from development to production, upgrades, installations and configurations
* Make decisions in security and regulatory policies to design and implement foolproof secured network solutions
* Assess changes for risk to production systems and assure quality, security and compliance requirements are met for supported areas
* Identify gaps in current technology processes and recommend changes to assure Service Level Agreements can be supported
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of Network Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Advance DDI skill and experience in US Banking organizations
* Knowledge in one or more scripting languages (Perl, Python). Understanding of REST APIs used by the enterprise.
* Experience in using JIRA, GitHub and Confluence.
* Good knowledge of Agile methodologies and Kanban principles
* Must be organized and have rigorous attention to detail.
* At least 5\+ years of experience managing and supporting a top\-tier DDI product such as Infoblox or Bluecat on large enterprise network environments.
* The candidate must possess in\-depth technical knowledge of the competitive vendor landscape and be adept at translating complex technology terms for executive levels and internal customers. Additionally, must actively apply their broad knowledge across network and security disciplines and possess a comprehensive network vision.
* Advanced network troubleshooting skills and extensive knowledge of network protocols and technologies such as Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, Manual/Static/Dynamic DHCP, DNS, BIND, DNS, etc.
* Experience with network management and monitoring tools (Syslog, Grafana, Broadcom, Splunk).
* Demonstrates excellent oral and written communication with the ability to communicate at all organizational levels clearly and effectively.
* Expertise in global service delivery in Technology Infrastructure Engineering \& Operations domain
* Good negotiation, conflict resolution and decision\-making skills.
* Industry certification like DDIP or any core DDI certification.
* Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in Engineering/Technology disciplines

**Job Expectations:**

* Work closely with other engineers, leads, and other lines of business to provide holistic DNS, DHCP, NTP, IP Address Management, and Domain Management administration and operations support for our business.
* Work closely with management/Leads in identifying, planning, designing, and managing the execution of internal projects and service improvement initiatives.
* Responsible for the welfare and development of the DDI services for the Bank within the established Service Level Objectives.
* Provide technical expertise of various Network technologies including but not limited to DNS, DHCP, IP address Management, Load Balancing and Network Security products.
* Consults with technical groups, users and/or vendors to identify and influence functional specifications and business/technical requirements.
* Proposes and creates conceptual network design/hardware reconfiguration and implementation methods.
* Design, document, test, maintain, and provide issue resolution recommendations for highly complex DDI and NTP solutions.
* Plans and oversees network studies and traffic analyses. Oversees forecasts of network traffic and capacity.
* Design work is creative, unique, sophisticated and complex.
* Understands and ensures compliance and risk management requirements for supported area are met.
* Need to be capable of creating technical/engineering/business logic documentation and collaborate with automation teams to develop the features.
* Responsible for investigating, troubleshooting, and resolving complex and high impacting incidents primarily on the DNS, DHCP and IP address management solutions and infrastructure used at Bank.
* Provide periodic 24/7 on\-call support rotation and some work will be required to be done during off hours if essential.
* Extensive experience in DNS (Domain Name Services), DHCP (Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol) \& IPAM (IP Address Management) Systems, with ample experience on DNS software (BIND, Microsoft DNS) and DHCP software (ISC), Anycast \& NTP Services on large enterprise environments.
* Ample experience with IP Address Management (IPv4 \& IPv6\)
